scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the graded-reading story “Hansel and Gretel”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 0: after their parents leave them in the forest, Hansel and Gretel follow the small white pebbles shining in moonlight along the path toward home.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet European woodland at night, with a winding path, simple dark tree silhouettes and a pale moon above. A sparse trail of small white pebbles catches the moonlight from foreground toward the distant path.
Subject: Hansel is a slim boy with short dark-brown hair, a cream shirt, simple brown suspenders and brown trousers. His younger sister Gretel has a dark-brown braid tied with a muted red ribbon and wears a rust-red dress. They walk side by side, looking toward the path, calm and relieved. Use the story cover only as a guide for their identities and muted cream, brown and rust clothing palette; keep the inline illustration much simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children's storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, soft contours, minimal texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape around 12:7, medium-wide view with the siblings and a clearly visible but sparse pebble trail, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: cool moonlight with a few soft warm highlights, safe, quiet and hopeful.
Color palette: midnight indigo, soft blue-grey, warm ivory pebbles, muted brown and a little rust red.
Constraints: show only the siblings returning home by following white pebbles; their parents are already gone. Natural child proportions and simple readable silhouettes.
Avoid: bread crumbs, birds, witch, candy house, cages, danger, readable text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, frightening faces.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the graded-reading story “Hansel and Gretel”
Primary request: depict the children’s arrival at the sweet-covered cottage after paragraph 1: Hansel and Gretel taste the house, and a kindly-seeming old woman comes to the doorway to welcome them.
Scene/backdrop: a small cottage in a quiet woodland clearing. Its walls are simple cookie-brown shapes, the roof is dark chocolate, and a few bright sweets decorate the windows; keep the architecture simplified and the candy details sparse.
Subject: Hansel, a slim boy with short dark-brown hair, cream shirt, brown suspenders and trousers, stands beside Gretel, his younger sister with a dark-brown braid, rust-red dress and small basket. They look curious and hungry, with one small piece missing from an outside cookie edge. A kindly elderly woman in a plain plum shawl and cream apron opens the door and welcomes them with a gentle expression. Use the story cover only as a guide for the children’s identity and clothing colours; keep this inline painting much simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children's storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, soft contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape around 12:7, medium-wide view, cottage doorway and three figures clearly readable at small inline size, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft afternoon light, inviting and curious.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted cream and brown, restrained rust-red, gentle sage and a little candy pink.
Constraints: portray only the apparently welcoming arrival. The old woman looks ordinary and kind, without witch-like details. Original characters and cottage.
Avoid: cages, oven, weapons, threats, magic, horror, frightening faces, excess candy, readable text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the graded-reading story “Hansel and Gretel”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 2: Hansel and Gretel have escaped the sweet-covered cottage and are carrying the witch’s small chest of gems through the forest.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet woodland path just beyond the cottage clearing, with broad tree silhouettes and a little daylight opening ahead. Keep the candy house distant and partly hidden.
Subject: Hansel, a slim boy with short dark-brown hair, cream shirt, brown suspenders and brown trousers, walks beside Gretel, his younger sister with a dark-brown braid, muted rust-red dress and small basket. Together they carry a modest wooden chest with a few colourful gemstones visible inside. Their expressions are focused but relieved. Use the story cover only as a guide for their identities and cream, brown and rust clothing palette; make the inline painting simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children's storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, soft contours, minimal texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape around 12:7, medium-wide view with both children and the chest clearly readable at small inline size, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, hopeful and calm after a difficult escape.
Color palette: gentle sage greens, warm ivory, muted brown, a little rust red, and restrained jewel colours.
Constraints: show the children safely walking away with the chest, without depicting how they escaped. Original child and cottage designs.
Avoid: witch, oven, cage, violence, chase, frightening mood, extra people, readable text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture.
